categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Suochen Information Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, sales, and services of CAE (Computer Aided Engineering) software. Its main products include engineering simulation software covering fluid dynamics, structural analysis, electromagnetics, acoustics, optics, and measurement and control, as well as customized simulation product development services for various engineering fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops core algorithms in multiple disciplines such as fluid dynamics (using gas kinetic schemes, DSMC, SPH), structural simulation (meshless particle methods, crack propagation algorithms), acoustics, electromagnetics, optics, and multi-physics coupled simulation engines. It emphasizes high-performance computing, parallel computing on CPU, GPU, and domestic DCU platforms, and integrates AI-driven generative digital twin technologies. The R&D process includes in-house development of core solver modules and outsourcing non-core modules to improve efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in defense, aerospace, shipbuilding, and high-end manufacturing sectors requiring advanced industrial software for product design and optimization. The company also serves research institutes and enterprises focused on industrial software applications, with a strong presence in domestic markets emphasizing industrial software localization and autonomous control.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with registered offices in Shanghai and subsidiaries in other Chinese cities such as Guangzhou and Beijing. It also has overseas subsidiaries in the United States, Hong Kong, and the United Kingdom, supporting international technology development and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suochen Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the industrial software supply chain, focusing on the development and provision of core CAE software tools and simulation platforms that serve downstream manufacturing and engineering design enterprises.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment (28.49% of revenue in 2024) to maintain technological leadership in CAE core algorithms and AI integration. Strategic directions include advancing physical AI platforms, generative AI for digital twins, multi-physics simulation integration, cloud-based simulation platforms, and expanding into vertical industry solutions such as aerospace, new energy, robotics, and low-altitude economy. It also pursues strategic acquisitions to enhance product offerings and ecosystem development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of proprietary engineering simulation software and customized simulation product development services. Additional income comes from technical services and machining services. The company does not use distributors but sells directly to customers, often through bidding and negotiation processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The domestic CAE software market is dominated by foreign companies such as Ansys, Dassault, Siemens, and MSC. Suochen Technology positions itself as a leading domestic CAE software provider, focusing on independent innovation and breaking foreign monopolies. It is the first domestic CAE software company listed on the A-share market and holds a strong position in China’s industrial software sector with a comprehensive product matrix and deep R&D capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 378.8 million, an 18.24% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 41.4 million, a 27.89% decrease. Total assets were about RMB 3.07 billion. The company maintains high R&D investment and is in a growth phase, expanding through acquisitions and new product development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suochen Technology emphasizes its fully independent core technology and solver algorithms, high-performance computing capabilities, and integration of AI-driven generative digital twin technology. Its unified data structure enables seamless parameter adjustments across the simulation workflow, enhancing efficiency and accuracy. The company offers comprehensive multi-disciplinary simulation solutions tailored to complex engineering needs, supporting domestic industrial software autonomy and security requirements.
